lines.text: @maya_front sits behind the wheel of @car_red, her first car.
She grips the wheel with both hands.
She takes a breath and turns the key.
The engine catches. Her eyes go wide, then bright.
@car_red rolls out of the driveway into golden light.
She laughs, window down, hair in the wind.

writes.note: I drafted a short, visual first-car scene from your line.

reply.rationale: One location, six short beats (about 12 s) that expand the person's action into a small arc, with no dialogue so the visuals carry it.
